current_maintainer_amendment.requirement: Allow the training workload up to 80 percent per core; exclude unrelated applications from that accounting. Keep all cores and threads eligible.
current_maintainer_amendment.supersedes: The historical below-50-percent requirement and conservative 3.33-percent whole-machine training limit below.

validation.windows_child_probe: Passed: queried job rate 8000 and flags 5 before launch; child confirmed 80-percent setting, affinity 4095 and Idle priority.
validation.integration_status: Prepared for future training; the next runner must adopt the cooperative helper before training starts. No current per-core enforcement claim.

current_maintainer_amendment.per_core_strategy: Cooperative synchronous work/rest cycles with an 80-percent active-time budget. The aggregate Windows job cap alone is not a per-core limiter.
current_maintainer_amendment.scope: Future training invocations must bind the new launcher and wrap synchronous work with the cooperative limiter. Historical runs and currently authenticated validation sources remain unchanged.
current_maintainer_amendment.limitations: The per-core claim is an average over completed work/rest cycles, not an instantaneous limit. All workload threads must be quiescent during rest; asynchronous workers and preparation outside guarded blocks are not covered. Combining the 80-percent job cap and fixed 80-percent work/rest duty can reduce fully saturated throughput toward 64 percent aggregate capacity.

maintainer_requirement: Training must stay below 50 percent per core on the replacement CPU.

resource_policy.rationale: Conservatively bound the entire job below half of one logical processor's CPU-time capacity. All logical processors remain eligible; the cap does not rely on even scheduling across cores.
resource_policy.limitation: Windows CPU-rate control limits scheduled CPU time over intervals, not instantaneous utilization. Other user applications are outside this job and may raise total core utilization.

historical_recipe: V43's recorded 16-thread recipe remains immutable. A future training invocation must explicitly bind its replacement-CPU recipe and verify export parity; do not silently reinterpret prior evidence.

concurrent_light_verification.scope: Small model-free verification only. Keep one training job at rate 333 and at most one verification job at rate 66; never run another normal-rate job concurrently.

application_quota_compatibility.failure: Physical-core default exceeded Environment.ProcessorCount under the Windows Job CPU quota; application mapping failed before model inference.
application_quota_compatibility.repair: Clamp the default inference thread count to the process-visible allowance while preserving physical-core metadata and rejecting excessive explicit overrides.
